title: Add Average True Range (ATR) and the Directional System (+DI/-DI/ADX)
description: Two indicators from Elder ch. 24, missing entirely from this codebase (confirmed via grep: no `true_range`, `atr`, `directional_system`, or `adx` anywhere in app/), sharing one prerequisite (`True Range`) so implement it once. `TR = max(high-low, |high-prev_close|, |low-prev_close|)`. `ATR` = N-day average of TR (13 default). Directional System: `+DM`/`-DM` = the portion of today's high-low range extending beyond yesterday's, signed by direction; `+DI`/`-DI` = smoothed(`DM`/`TR`)*100 (13-day smoothing default); `DX` = `|+DI - -DI| / (+DI + -DI) * 100`; `ADX` = smoothed `DX`. Elder treats ADX-rising-from-a-lull (specifically: rising 4 steps from its lowest point, e.g. 9->13) as a concrete early-new-trend signal, and ADX direction as the gate for whether to trust trend-following logic at all right now. This task is indicator computation + hand-computed reference-value tests + API exposure ONLY -- wiring ADX into `_determine_signal`'s actual gating logic, or into the trend/range regime idea, is explicitly out of scope here (a separate methodology decision, not an indicator-plumbing one).

checklist.step: Implement true_range(), atr(), plus_minus_dm(), plus_minus_di(), dx(), adx() in a new backend/app/indicators/directional_system.py (or split atr into its own module if that reads cleaner -- decide and record).

Hand-computed reference-value tests for each function (per add-indicator skill convention) -- at minimum a small hand-verifiable OHLC series with known TR/DM/DI/DX/ADX values worked out by hand, not just golden-output regression tests.

Expose the new fields on the existing WaveScreen or a new screens.trend_strength object in GET /api/stocks/{ticker}/analysis and the indicator-history endpoint -- decide the shape and record as a decisions entry.
Document the indicators in docs/Analyse.md's indicator table, citing this task.
